text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since Kawakami Princess didn't show up for 
practice, I went looking for her based on 
what other Umamusume told me.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Just as expected from an art exhibit 
King-san praised so highly♪ My sense of 
aesthetics has been refined to an insane 
degree!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ With this, I'm one step closer to 
becoming a super noble lady just like 
King...
choice_data_list: A King never forgets to practice, right?

A King never forgets to practice, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, of course she will~! King-san would 
never make such a silly mistak—...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Wait, if it isn't Trainer. Practice is... 
wait...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Gyafun! T-T-T-Today was a practice day, 
wasn't it~~!!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I am so sorry~! It completely and utterly 
slipped my mind~...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seems to truly regret it. I cautioned 
her that self-improvement is fine, but 
training comes first...
